name: Files changed opens in Smart Diff order and toggles back to the original
description: From PR #482, open the Files changed tab and confirm the reviewer-ordered diff (L03 Smart Diff): the seeded files group into Core logic and Wiring, each group carries the description that says how much attention it deserves, and src/config.ts — flagged CRITICAL on line 12 by the seeded review — reports its finding in the file header and marks the line itself. The seeded PR is 134 changed lines, so the 'This PR is large' split banner must NOT appear. Then toggle to Original order (the choice lands in ?order= so it survives leaving the tab) and back, and finally click a severity mark to cross to the Agent runs tab with that exact finding revealed. Read-only seeded data; GET /pulls/:id/smart-diff is deterministic (no model call, no keys). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api (PR #482) is the first repo — run locally via the hermetic stack (see e2e/README.md).
